items.markdown:
![The Product Development Life Cycle: From Ideation to Launch](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/10081734-2633-0066-0000-2737c0cebc2e:4)
Product development is the complete journey of creating and launching a new product or improving an existing one to meet customer needs and increase a company's market value.[[1]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/product-development)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I0bTD5_p1MI&t=41)[[3]](https://www.vationventures.com/glossary/product-development-definition-explanation-and-use-cases)[[4]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/product-development)

### Key Stages of Product Development

The process typically moves through structured phases from strategy to launch according to frameworks like [Atlassian](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/product-management/product-development) and [Coursera](https://www.coursera.org/articles/product-development):

- **Ideation & Research:** Brainstorming core ideas, analyzing market demand, and evaluating competitors.
- **Concept Development:** Screening ideas against business goals and defining the value proposition or minimum viable product (MVP).
- **Prototyping & Design:** Building early models, sketches, or digital mockups to test core functionality and user experience.
- **Testing & Validation:** Running technical, engineering, and market tests to fix issues before mass production.
- **Commercialization & Launch:** Finalizing pricing, scaling production, and executing the go-to-market and marketing strategy.[[1]](https://www.atlassian.com/agile/product-management/product-development)[[2]](https://www.coursera.org/articles/product-development)[[3]](https://asana.com/resources/product-development-process)[[4]](https://www.openpr.com/news/4654940/lkk-design-enables-global-product-innovation-from-design)

### Core Team Roles
Cross-functional teams drive the product development lifecycle:

- **Product Manager:** Owns the strategy, vision, roadmap, and alignment across teams.
- **Engineers & Developers:** Build the technical mechanics, software, or physical structure of the product.
- **Product Designers:** Focus on aesthetics, user interface, and overall usability.
- **Product Marketers:** Handle positioning, customer messaging, and launch promotion.[[1]](https://www.productplan.com/learn/what-is-product-development)[[2]](https://www.ibm.com/think/topics/product-development)[[3]](https://www.aha.io/roadmapping/guide/what-is-product-development)[[4]](https://www.openpr.com/news/4654940/lkk-design-enables-global-product-innovation-from-design)

Are you working on a **physical product** or a **digital/software product** , and what stage of the process are you in right now?
